estimates.assumptions: Zest of 1 medium orange (~6g); ~15 kcal from peel oils and fiber.
1/4 cup (~60g) fresh orange juice; standard values for unsweetened.
1/4 cup (~60ml) regular soy sauce; ~35 kcal from protein/salt.
1/4 cup (60ml) water contributes zero macros.
1/3 cup (~80ml) rice vinegar; negligible macros at this dilution.
1 tbsp (~8g) cornstarch; ~30 kcal from carbohydrate.
1 tbsp (~14g) sesame oil; standard oil values.
1/2 cup (~100g) granulated sugar; fully caloric carbohydrate.
650g raw boneless skinless chicken thighs; ~135 kcal, 17g protein, 6.8g fat per 100g (edible portion).
2 large eggs (~100g total); standard large egg nutrition.
1 tsp table salt contributes zero caloric macros.
1/4 tsp ground black pepper; negligible at this quantity.
1/2 cup (~64g) cornstarch; ~120 kcal per 1/4 cup, all from carbs.
1/2 cup (~60g) all-purpose flour; standard white flour values.
2 cups (480ml) vegetable oil for frying; only ~10g (1 tbsp) actually absorbed by the 650g chicken during shallow pan-frying in two batches (remainder poured out).
2 cloves garlic chopped (~6g); standard values.
1 chopped shallot (~15g); modest size assumed.
Sliced scallions for garnish; modest handful (~10g) used as garnish only.
Sesame seeds for garnish; modest sprinkle (~4g) over whole recipe.
Rice 'to serve' is an omitted side dish, not an ingredient in the recipe itself; cannot estimate without specified quantity.
